prompts.name: paladin_common_armor_labeled
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create actual raster sprite-sheet art for an original grimdark isometric dungeon crawler. Strong dark fantasy anime anatomy: very slender adult male paladin, long narrow limbs, small head, angular weary face, narrow shoulders, lean waist. Right-facing three-quarter isometric view, every frame faces screen RIGHT. Hand-placed LOW RESOLUTION pixel aesthetic, approximately 24-32 pixels wide and 64 pixels high per character, crisp chunky pixel clusters, 16-24 muted colors per outfit, almost black shadows, jagged ink-like contours, worn metal, torn fabric. Restrained grim anime expression. Absolutely no chibi, no stock cute pixel art, no broad bulky heroic body, no smooth painting, no anti-aliasing, no 3D render. The attached roster is only a class identity reference; aggressively replace its bulky, polished, high-detail rendering. True transparent background, no baked checkerboard, no scenery. Consistent scale and ample empty padding in every cell.
LABELING IS REQUIRED: use readable small pixel text in dedicated left label gutter for every row and a top header margin. Labels must never overlap art. Label atlas title, rarity, row asset ID and exact name; label animation columns. Keep all art-cell spacing uniform. Transparent background behind sprites, muted ivory lettering.
PALADIN — COMMON ARMOR. Large square atlas, exactly TEN rows of characters with TWELVE animation columns, plus left label gutter and top titles. Do not omit the tenth row. Each row = one different outfit. Label columns 'ATK1' 'ATK2' 'ATK3' 'ATK4' 'ATK5' 'ATK6' 'CAST1' 'CAST2' 'CAST3' 'CAST4' 'CAST5' 'CAST6'. Six melee frames = ready, draw back, overhead windup, strike toward right, followthrough, recover. Six cast frames = rest, raise hand, gather, extend, release, recover. Empty hands with grips for separate weapons. No helmets, weapons, shields, magic or scenery baked into body. Bare head with same lean dark-haired masculine anime face in all cells. Repeat each row's outfit exactly over its 12 poses, with real sequential movement. Uniform cell size and consistent feet anchor. Actual low resolution hard PIXELS, not tiny high-resolution paintings. Draw ten DIFFERENT construction/silhouettes, not color swaps. Exact row labels and outfit designs top to bottom:
P01 Ragged Pilgrim: patched charcoal gambeson and rope belt
P02 Rust Lamellar: rusty narrow lamellar with torn brown waistcloth
P03 Soot Chapel: battered iron breastplate over soot-grey pilgrim robes
P04 Scrap Sentinel: asymmetrical scrap-steel shoulder and burgundy surcoat
P05 Bone Tabard: chainmail with bone-white ragged tabard
P06 Road Brigand: riveted leather brigandine and split olive skirt
P07 Black Rivet: blackened studded jack with wrapped greaves
P08 Tin Votary: dull tin scale-mail and frayed blue sash
P09 Prayer Cuirass: worn ribbed cuirass with tan prayer strips
P10 Ringmail Exile: patched ringmail with ragged long dark clerical coat
Draw every listed row, including the last. Reserve generous separate gutters for readable ivory labels, nothing overlaid on art. Transparent background everywhere except art and typography. All bodies slender and right-facing.

prompts.name: paladin_weapons_shields_labeled
prompts.prompt:

prompts.name: paladin_common_abilities_labeled
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a labeled LOW RESOLUTION animated ability-effects sprite atlas for an original grimdark anime-influenced isometric dungeon crawler. PALADIN — COMMON ABILITIES. Exactly TEN ROWS, SIX COLUMNS of sprites plus left text gutter and top header. Each row has six successive animation frames of ONE distinct spell effect. Columns labeled '1 START' '2 GATHER' '3 RELEASE' '4 PEAK' '5 DECAY' '6 FADE'. No characters, no equipment, no scenery, true transparent background. Small compact effects, native pixel impression 24 to 48 pixels across, hard jagged pixel clusters, stepped outlines, small restrained muted palettes, no soft glow or blurred digital painting, no generic bright mobile game icon style.
